# Pre-finance upgrade fixture

Synthetic data generated with the test driver from `main` at `126d459`
(schema v3). No customer data or credentials are included.

The fixture contains a synthetic blank PNG with a supplied OCR result and
manual correction, a submitted claim with a minimal pdf-lib PDF passed through
the release's export-completion command, a CSV generated by the release, one
manual draft expense, preferences, and 12 audit events. It is deliberately an
actual v3 database rather than one constructed with the current migrations.
The fixture tests migration and preservation, not OCR accuracy or the full
claim-report renderer; those have separate end-to-end tests.

`tests/upgrade.rs` copies this directory to temporary storage before opening
it. Never run the app directly on the checked-in fixture: that would migrate
the source database and invalidate the upgrade test. Do not include WAL or
shared-memory files in this directory.
